opening.argument: The speaker presents a Bitcoin-funded trading operation through their team, promoting approximately 0.5% daily and 12% monthly returns while directing viewers toward participation beginning at $100 and suggesting $200 as a starting amount. The description identifies an AI trading bot and states, "Avg. 12% monthly Fund with BTC Only." The speaker reinforces the returns claim by saying, "we've been averaging monthly 12%" and describes Bitcoin payments and trading performed for participants. The recruitment structure adds that, "once you get a person on your left and right at 100," viewers qualify for the binary and receive additional payment. Daily-income graphics and a trading-result display accompany these claims, but they do not establish transferred or withdrawn funds.

citations.quote: AI trading bot (been out since Aug 2019) Avg. 12% monthly Fund with BTC Only
And once you get a person on your left and right at 100. You will be qualified for the binary and get paid that also
